title: Tamache Khaye
body:
Tamache Khaye
Haye sakina haye sakina - 2
Haaye mazluma haye sakina
Haye masuma haye sakina
Haaye sakina
Paani masuma me maanga to tamache khaaye - 2
Paani masuma ne maanga to tamache khaaye - 2
Roke baba ko bulaya to tamache khaaye
1. Chinne aaya jo zainab ki rida bacchi ne - 2
Shimr ko rokna chaha to tamache khaaye
<<DIVIDER>>
2. Jalte khayme se nikalte hue shehzadi ne - 2
Raasta pucha najaf ka to tamache khaaye
<<DIVIDER>>
3. Dhundti thi wo tamacho ki shikayat ke liye - 2
Mil gaya baap ka laasha to tamache khaaye
<<DIVIDER>>
4. Gir gayi thi wo kahi chalte hue naake se - 2
Shimr jab dhund ke laaya to tamache khaaye
<<DIVIDER>>
5. Apne chehro ko tamacho se bachane ke liye - 2
Nanhe haatho se chupaya to tamache khaaye
<<DIVIDER>>
6. Ye to accha hi hua dil me kaha karti thi - 2
Naa rahe jab mere baba to tamache khaaye
<<DIVIDER>>
7. Khaaye zainab ne kayi durre bhatije ke liye - 2
Isne baqir ko bachaya to tamache khaaye
<<DIVIDER>>
8. Kufao shaam ke bazaro me chalte chalte - 2
Thak ke baythi jo sakina to tamache khaaye
<<DIVIDER>>
9. Mir sajjad sakina bhi hai zahra ki tarha - 2
Ho gayi jab ye yateema to tamache khaaye
